notes.title: Baby Blues Nightmares Achievement Update - Controller Input And Checkpoints!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you are all well. 👶🎮

Been hard at work to improve your experience with Baby Blues Nightmare, and very excited to bring you Update v1.2.3. This update introduces some exciting new features as well as several critical bug fixes to ensure smoother gameplay.

[b]New Features:[/b]

🛑 Achievements Added!
You asked for it, and here it is. The game now have Achievements added! 

New Features on v1.2.3:

[list]
[*] The game now have a set of 5 achievements which you can get.
[*] Fixed a bug issue where for some reason the game was crashing at certain parts.
[*] Added more checkpoints in the game. That means once the game is restarted it will start you from a more earlier checkpoint instead. 
[*] Some jumpscares in the game have been altered. 
[*] Some sound effects in the game have been altered. 
[*] More landmarks have been added into the game, making it a bit more easy to pinpoint locations.
[*] Additional small bug fixes have been made to the game.
[/list]

As always - thank you so much for trying the game out and hope you all have a great day!

Feel free to also join in the discord server here: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

notes.title: Baby Blues Nightmares Update V1.2.2 - Controller Input And Checkpoints!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you are doing well! Happy to say that I am currently working on Controller input - and it seems that now is working fine! Before it had the issue where doing certain actions (Like opening a door, for example) lock up the player and then you have to pause the game in order to get back on track. The issue have been resolved, and the game can now be played with the controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894889/a7c625dda2c994219d993897260ad79f981f103a.png[/img]

To enable Controller - you have to plug in your controller, go to SETTINGS and select the detected controller from the dropdown menu. Click on APPLY and it should enable your controller input.

[b]I will be fixing some issues that come up for the controller in later update - so do let me know if you encounter any! [/b]

This update also added checkpoints for every objectives that you complete. Thanks to some user feedback, it was a bit annoying to lose your progress if you forgot to save. Some additional bug fixes, sound issues and more. 

[b]New Features on v1.2.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added / Fixed controller input. Now you can use the controller by changing it from the menu.
[*] Fixed the bug issue where if you have a controller plugged in, some actions will freeze the game.
[*] Added "checkpoints" on objectives. That means, on some objectives there will be checkpoints and autosaves now. This can be useful if for example, you forgot to save in the safe room. 
[*] Additional bugs and grammar mistakes have been fixed.
[*] The sound effects of certain events, especially jumpscares have been decreased. 
[*] Additional changes have been made to the map, such as more landmark markings.
[*] Additional markers have been created inside the map.
[*] Additional bug fixes have been made to the game. 
[/list]

As always - thank you so much for trying the game out and hope you all have a great day!

Feel free to also join in the discord server here: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

notes.title: Baby Blues Nightmares - Update V1.2.1 - Sound Fixes, Dolls Voices And More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you are doing well! I am currently updating the game within your feedback - so please don't hesitate to give me any that you have. I really appreciate it and this really helps improve the game!

This update focus on additional bug fixes, sound issues and also added voiceover for the dolls. Once you are near them, sometimes they call you out to let you know you are near! ːsteamhappyː

[b]New Features on v1.2.1:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added VO to dolls objectives, when player is near they can call you out to let you know you are near your target. Hopefully this helps with some players being lost.
[*] Alternate the sound design of the game, make it more clear especially in the intro cutscene.
[*] Added the option to turn off the bass of the game after the intro for the first chapter.
[*] Additional bugs and grammar mistakes have been fixed. 
[*] Player overall stamina have been increased.
[*] Additional changes have been made to the map, markings such as the wheel can now be found easier.
[*] Additional markers have been created in the map, which helps in guiding you where you need to go.
[*] Certain jumpscares have also been reworked and updated.
[/list]

Currently still working on fixing some controller issues and getting it to fully work on the steamdeck. I appreciate you all and thank you so much! Have a great day all!

Feel free to also join in the discord server here: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

notes.title: Baby Blues Nightmares - Update V1.2 - New Mode+, Bug Fixes And More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you are doing well! Welcome to the first update of Baby Blues Nightmares! It was crazy, but hopefully this will fix some of the issues thanks to your feedback.

Firstly, I wish to take the time to tell you that I really appreciate all your support, comments, feedback and suggestions. I hope you enjoyed the game and if not - please don't hesitate to let me know your feedback. It really helps me out as a solo developer in trying my best to improve along the way!

The first update is now [b]LIVE.[/b] It took some time because I was doing some major changes and huge bug fixes that I saw from certain playthroughs. Also a HUGE thank you everyone that played the game as well and recorded it! You have no idea how much this helps.

[b]Thanks to the awesome feedback from many of you, I've implemented a highly requested feature - Replay Mode+ - You can now replay back Chapter 3 at your own pace![/b] 🎮

I will be going through the biggest changes and list them here. One of them is the new [b]Replay Mode+[/b]. This allows you to replay and start the game from the free roam chapter (Chapter 3) for you to do it at your own pace, find secrets and discover the map. This game mode unlocks after you have finished the game. 

[b]New Features on v1.2:[/b]

[b]Replay Mode+: [/b] A lot of players mentioned they couldn’t easily replay the game because starting over from the first chapter was too tedious. And you were totally right! This new mode unlocks after you completed half of Chapter 3. It will appear in the Main Menu and then when you select it - which you can start a new game in the free-roam chapter and you can replay it at your own pace, find secrets, customize your tricycle, do things you missed and more!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zrnpv07/PZ8UTZax.png[/img]

[b]Updated Map: [/b] Map have been improved and updated. In the map, you can zoom in much closer using your mouse scroll wheel and lots of landmarks have been updated which will make it easier to navigate the child care!

[b]Saving System: [/b] You can now load your previous game files from any chapter - from Chapter 1 all the way to Chapter 5. Multiple save slots are now available, so you can keep different progress points instead of being forced to overwrite a single save file.

[b]Please note 1:[/b] Some saving system can be corrupted due to this update. If so, I really apologize. It's advised to re-start to an earlier save or start at the start of Chapter 3.

[b]PLEASE NOTE 2: [/b] If you have a save in Chapter 3, it's best you start an earlier save. Find the first save you have from Chapter 3 and reload it. This is to ensure there will be no bugs in the game because of the saving update.

[b]Item Spawns: [/b] From playthroughs I noticed many players were getting lost or having trouble finding certain items and objectives. To help with this, the following improvements have been made: New object points have been added throughout the game, spawning in various locations. These changes make it easier to find key items and navigate to important objectives, reducing frustration while trying to maintain the thrill of exploration.

Apart from these changes above there were other smaller ones such as these:

[list]
[*] Fixed crash issues happening to some players. This was very hard to pinpoint - but hopefully it's been fixed. Let me know if some of you are still getting this error.
[*] Increased the enemies eye sight and speed.
[*] Updated some sounds and audio in the game.
[*] Updated a ton of bug fixed and issues in the game.
[*] Some jumpscares have also been reworked and updated.
[*] Done some in-game optimizations.
[*] Updated prefabs and textures in some areas.
[/list]

Next I will be working on controller, steamdeck and some other things. Please do let me know if you have any suggestions of feedbacks! It really helps out. I appreciate you all! Thanks and have a great day!
